financial_phrasebank.source: HF atrost/financial_phrasebank (parquet mirror of takala/financial_phrasebank, config sentences_50agree; labels >=50% annotator agreement; takala's loader script is unsupported by datasets>=4)

twitter_financial_news_sentiment.role: entirely held out; cross-dataset test only, never used for training or selection

prosus_finbert_as_is.caveat: FinBERT was trained on Financial PhraseBank; this PhraseBank-test score is not independent evidence.

notes: Primary data: Financial PhraseBank sentences_50agree (>=50% annotator agreement; noisier labels than allagree, so the accuracy ceiling is lower).

ProsusAI/finbert was trained on Financial PhraseBank, so its PhraseBank-test score is NOT independent evidence (test sentences were likely in its training data). Its cross-dataset score on Twitter is the fairer comparison: 0.7149.
Untuned baseline = distilbert-base-uncased with a randomly initialised 3-way head, no training, scored on the same test split.
Epoch/lr selected on VALIDATION only (lr grid [3e-05, 5e-05], up to 4 epochs): lr=3e-05 epoch=4 val_acc=0.8703.
cv_mean/cv_std: 5-fold stratified CV on train+val (4110 rows) using the selected lr and epoch count; sample std (ddof=1). Test set not included in CV.
test_acc_ci95: bootstrap (2000 resamples) percentile CI on test accuracy, split=test.
cross_dataset_acc: fine-tuned model on zeroshot/twitter-financial-news-sentiment (train+val merged, n=11924), never trained on; TF-IDF LR gets 0.6554, FinBERT 0.7149 there.
